objective: Create the frozen type contract for the approved modular weapon Forge. This is the first small coding leaf; no other files may change.

edits.instructions: Create a TypeScript type-only file importing WeaponDef from './types'. Export interface ForgeRecipe { weaponId: string; traitId: string; abilityId: string; radianceId: string }. Export interface ForgeOption { id: string; name: string; description: string; params: Record<string, number> }. Export interface ForgeTrait extends ForgeOption { kind: 'bless' | 'curse' }. Export interface ForgeRadiance { id: string; name: string; color: string }. Export interface ForgeConfig { weapons: WeaponDef[]; abilities: ForgeOption[]; traits: ForgeTrait[]; radiances: ForgeRadiance[]; defaults: { traitId: string; abilityId: string; radianceId: string }; limits: { maxCopies: number; auraEverySteps: number; poisonTickSteps: number; poisonDamage: number; shieldBreakSteps: number; traitCooldownSteps: number }; enemyAttack: { radius: number; density: number; speed: number; lifetimeSteps: number; bossDensity: number; bossSpeed: number; volleyCount: number; volleySpacing: number } }. Keep this exact contract. No executable logic, dependencies, or edits to other files.

acceptance_checks.expected: Existing checks pass; new file is valid type-only TypeScript.
